```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")
crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> select(category_id, category_name),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(
    category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap_usd /
           sum(category_market_cap_usd) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = date,
    y = category_share,
    fill = forcats::fct_reorder(
      category_name, category_share, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE
    )
  )) +
  geom_area() +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"), xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = 0, ymax = 100, fill = "grey20", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"), xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = 0, ymax = 100, fill = "grey20", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"), y = 103,
    label = "Luna/UST crash", size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"), y = 103,
    label = "FTX collapse", size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Category") +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Each band shows its category's share of the combined market cap",
      "of the 22 tracked coins; bands sum to 100% each day."
    ),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of combined market cap",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: course-provided daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet,",
      "and categories.parquet."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
